R326.rule: CLAUDE.md §3/§10 — no service writes another service's schema
R326.evidence:
ALTER TABLE order_schema.orders
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS risk_flag VARCHAR(20);
R326.reason: A risk-service Flyway migration alters order-service's schema, breaking the one-schema-per-service boundary.

R329.rule: CLAUDE.md §10 — never execute without RISK_CHECK_PASSED / §5 state machine
R329.reason: Any non-REJECTED result (null, unknown, malformed) now advances the order to RISK_CHECK_PASSED, making the risk gate fail open.

R342.rule: CLAUDE.md §13h — never log BigDecimal monetary values at INFO or above
R342.evidence:
log.info("BUY fill applied: clientId={} symbol={} qty={} fillType={} fillValue={} cashBalance={}",
                        clientId, symbol, executedQty, fillType, fillValue, client.getCashBalance());
R342.reason: Logs fill value and client cash balance (monetary, sensitive client data) at INFO.

R349.evidence:
log.info("Execution completed consumed: orderId={} executionId={} fillType={}",
                orderId, payload.get("executionId"), fillType);
R349.reason: Adds a non-sensitive ID to an INFO log, consistent with logging rules.

R355.reason: POST /watchlist/{symbol} now returns a bare DTO instead of the mandatory {data, meta} envelope, breaking the API contract and consistency with sibling endpoints.

R413.reason: Adds a Spring read-only transaction to a pure read method; harmless and correct.

R433.rule: CLAUDE.md §9/§10 risk engine integrity; §13h/§13i exception handling
R433.reason: Swallows rule exceptions and skips the rule, so an erroring enabled risk rule silently passes the order (fail-open), and the exception/stack is dropped from the log.

R435.rule: CLAUDE.md §13a/§13f — enums stored as STRING, never ORDINAL
R435.reason: Switches fill_type persistence to ORDINAL, violating the rule and corrupting reads of existing STRING-valued rows.

R447.rule: CLAUDE.md §3/§10 — no cross-schema reads; cross-service via REST/Kafka only
R447.reason: order-service reads client-service's schema directly via a native query.

R505.reason: Integer arithmetic yields the same floor(60%) for positive quantities and removes floating-point imprecision; no rule or behavior regression.

R506.rule: CLAUDE.md §6 L2 #12 self-trade check / §9 risk rule integrity
R506.reason: MARKET orders (which order-service deliberately flags as always crossing) are exempted, so market-order self-trades are no longer rejected.

R524.rule: CLAUDE.md §10/§11 — never use Reactor (Mono/Flux); no new dependency
R524.reason: Introduces Reactor types and fire-and-forget async in a Kafka listener, also breaking retry/DLT semantics since failures no longer propagate to the container.

R527.rule: CLAUDE.md §6 L2 #13 buying power check — money correctness
R527.reason: Adds in-flight BUY commitments to available cash instead of subtracting them, inflating buying power and allowing over-commitment.
